data.content: In which sites was Iomeprol found to be a risk driver in Germany in 2010?

args.query: List all sampling sites in Germany where the substance Iomeprol is marked as a risk driver (IS_DRIVER) in the year 2010. Return site name, site ID, river/lake name if available, federal state, and the specific 2010 quarter(s) when Iomeprol was a driver.
